description: Add a website URL for the agent to crawl into its knowledge base. Returns the entry with its id and crawl status. Crawling is asynchronous - the knowledge is not available immediately; poll mba_get_website for crawl_status.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_create_website

crawl_status.description: The current status of the crawl (e.g., "pending", "in_progress", "completed", "failed")

created_at.description: The timestamp when the website entry was created

id.description: The unique identifier for this website crawl entry

last_crawled_at.description: The timestamp when the website was last successfully crawled

pages_crawled.description: The number of pages successfully crawled

url.description: The URL of the website being crawled

title: Add a website to crawl
